searchDocs.title: Waiting for data​
searchDocs.content: The server sends the initial data snapshot after the profile loads. Use playerDataSynced to wait for it:  Data.playerDataSynced:wait()   Or use Data.use(), which calls your callback once the data arrives:  Data:use(function(data) print(data.currency()) end)

searchDocs.title: Reading​
searchDocs.content: Always access the reactive root through :get():  local root = Data:get() local money = root.currency() local apples = root.inventory.apples()   The client is a read-only mirror. All changes come from the server — see Server for writing data.

searchDocs.title: Listening to changes​
searchDocs.content: The client's main job is reacting to server changes. .Changed fires when a field changes:  local disconnect = root.currency.Changed(function(currency, previous) print("Currency:", previous, "->", currency) end) -- Later: disconnect()   Listen to a parent table to catch changes in any child, and react to arrays and dictionaries with .OnInsert, .OnRemove, .OnKeyAdded, and .OnKeyRemoved:  root.inventory.Changed(function(inventory, previousChildValue, childKey) print(childKey, "changed") end) root.items.OnKeyAdded(function(key, item) print("New item:", key) end)   See Values for the full listen API.

searchDocs.title: Install​
searchDocs.content: pesde.toml [dependencies] create_player_data = { pesde = "sap0bombado/create_player_data@0.1.1" }   pesde install

searchDocs.title: Create your data module​
searchDocs.content: A shared module defines what every player's data looks like:  shared/player-data.luau local createPlayerData = require '@pkg/create_player_data' type ItemData = { health: number, dmg: number, } local template = { currency = 0, inventory = { apples = 5, oranges = 10, }, settings = { music = true, sfx = true, }, items = {} :: { [string]: ItemData }, equippedItemId = nil :: string?, questProgress = {} :: { number }, } export type template = typeof(template) return createPlayerData<<template>>({ template = template, })   Values must be JSON-safe: numbers, strings, booleans, arrays, dictionaries, and nil for optional keys. No Instances, CFrame, Vector3, functions, or userdata.

searchDocs.title: Require it​
searchDocs.content: -- Server local Data = require(path.to.Data).server -- Client local Data = require(path.to.Data).client

searchDocs.title: Load data​
searchDocs.content: create-player-data never loads players automatically. Call startSessionAsync in your own PlayerAdded handler:  local Players = game:GetService 'Players' Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) local ok = Data:startSessionAsync(player) if not ok then player:Kick 'Could not load your data. Please rejoin.' end end)   Once loaded, access the player's data with :get():  local playerData = Data:get(player) playerData.currency(50)   Data saves automatically when the player leaves. New keys added to the template are reconciled into existing profiles on their next load.

searchDocs.title: Next steps​
searchDocs.content: Server — loading, lifecycle, profiles, global messagesOptions — configuration referenceValues — reading, writing, and listening to reactive dataClient — the read-only mirror

searchDocs.title: Reading​
searchDocs.content: local price = playerData.currency() -- 50 local apples = playerData.inventory.apples() -- 5

searchDocs.title: Writing​
searchDocs.content: playerData.currency(50) -- set playerData.settings.music(false) -- set playerData.equippedItemId("wooden_sword") -- set playerData.equippedItemId(nil) -- clear optional values   Pass a function to update from the previous value:  playerData.currency(function(currency) return currency + 10 end) playerData.inventory.apples(function(apples) return math.max(0, apples - 1) end)

searchDocs.title: Arrays​
searchDocs.content: Typed arrays (e.g. {} :: { number }) get .Insert and .Remove:  playerData.questProgress.Insert(10) playerData.questProgress.Insert(15, 2) -- insert at position 2 local removed = playerData.questProgress.Remove(2) local last = playerData.questProgress.Remove() -- remove last

searchDocs.title: Dictionaries​
searchDocs.content: String-keyed dictionaries work like nested data. Set a key by assigning its table. Remove it with nil:  playerData.items.sword_001({ health = 0, dmg = 12, }) playerData.items.sword_001(nil) -- remove

searchDocs.title: Listening​
searchDocs.content: Every handling method returns a disconnect function.

searchDocs.title: .Changed​
searchDocs.content: Fires when a field changes, receiving the new value, previous value, and the key that changed:  local disconnect = playerData.currency.Changed(function(currency, previous) print("Currency:", previous, "->", currency) end) -- Later: disconnect()   Listen to a parent table to catch changes in any child:  playerData.inventory.Changed(function(inventory, previousChildValue, childKey) print(childKey, "changed") end)

searchDocs.title: .OnInsert / .OnRemove​
searchDocs.content: Fire when an item is inserted into or removed from an array:  playerData.questProgress.OnInsert(function(item, position) print("Inserted", item, "at", position) end) playerData.questProgress.OnRemove(function(item, position) print("Removed", item, "from", position) end)

searchDocs.title: .OnKeyAdded / .OnKeyRemoved​
searchDocs.content: Fire when a dictionary key goes from nil to a value, or from a value to nil:  playerData.items.OnKeyAdded(function(key, item) end) playerData.items.OnKeyRemoved(function(key, item) end)   Changing an existing key fires .Changed instead.

searchDocs.title: Essentials​
searchDocs.content: Option	What it doestemplate	Required. Default data shape for every player.

searchDocs.title: Storage​
searchDocs.content: Option	What it doesprofileStoreIndex	ProfileStore name. Defaults to "Default". profileStoreDataPrefix	Prefix before the user id in the profile key. Defaults to "PLAYER_".

searchDocs.title: Testing​
searchDocs.content: Option	What it doesuseMock	Uses ProfileStore mock storage for testing. dontSave	Loads with GetAsync instead of a write session. resetData	Removes the profile before loading.

searchDocs.title: Admin / inspection​
searchDocs.content: Option	What it doesviewedUserId	Loads another user's data for viewing, no write session. overridenUserId	Uses another user id as the active profile.

searchDocs.title: DataTemplate​
searchDocs.content: </> type DataTemplate = {[string]: any} Defines the structure of player data used by the DataServer. local datatemplate = { currency = 0, inventory = { apples = 5, oranges = 10, }, settings = { music = true, }, items = {} :: { [string]: ItemData }, array = {} :: { number }, } NOTE Player data automatically reconciles the template on join if new keys are added. WARNING Follow JSON rules for all data. (e.g., no Vector3, CFrame, etc.)

searchDocs.title: DataOptions​
searchDocs.content: </> interface DataOptions { template: DataTemplate-- Template dictionary for player data. profileStoreIndex: string-- Index for the ProfileStore. useMock: boolean?-- Use Mock data for testing. viewedUserId: number?-- User ID to view data for. Use to view a specific player's data without saving. overridenUserId: number?-- User ID to override for the profile. Use to play on another player's save. dontSave: boolean?-- Prevent saving the profile. Use for testing without saving. resetData: boolean?-- Reset the data on player join. Use to wipe data for testing. } local options = { template = require(path.to.datatemplate), profileStoreIndex = "Public", } Provides options for initializing the DataServer.

searchDocs.title: startSessionAsync​
searchDocs.content: This is a yielding function. When called, it will pause the Lua thread that called the function until a result is ready to be returned, without interrupting other scripts. Yields </> DataServer:startSessionAsync(player: Player ) → boolean Loads the player's data, starting a ProfileStore session and making it available through server[player]. Idempotent: if the player is already loaded, it returns true immediately. local ok = Data.server:startSessionAsync(player) if not ok then -- onSessionFail already fired end

searchDocs.title: endSession​
searchDocs.content: </> DataServer:endSession(player: Player ) → () Ends the player's profile session: saves and releases it, removesData.server[player], and fires onSessionEnd. Does not touch the Player instance or kick the player. Data.server:endSession(player)

searchDocs.title: resetData​
searchDocs.content: </> DataServer:resetData(player: Player ) → () Resets the data for the specified player by removing their profile from the store. The player is then kicked from the game with a message to rejoin. Data.server:resetData(player)

searchDocs.title: sendGlobalMessage​
searchDocs.content: </> DataServer:sendGlobalMessage( key: string, userId: number | string, data: {any} ) → boolean Sends a global message to the specified user's profile. Returns true if the message was sent successfully, false otherwise. Data.server:sendGlobalMessage("SendGift", userId, { currency = 100, from = "Friend" })

searchDocs.title: addGlobalCallback​
searchDocs.content: </> DataServer:addGlobalCallback( key: string, cb: ( player: Player , data: {any} ) → boolean? ) → () Adds a global callback function for handling messages with the specified key. The callback receives the player and data as parameters. If the callback returns false, the message is not processed further. Data.server:addGlobalCallback("SendGift", function(player: Player, data: { any }): boolean? print("Received gift for", player.Name, "with data:", data) -- Process the gift here end)

searchDocs.title: addPlayerRemovingCallback​
searchDocs.content: </> DataServer:addPlayerRemovingCallback(fn: ( player: Player , data: any ) → ()) → () Add any number of functions to be called when a player is removed. Used to perform cleanup or save data before the player leaves. Data.server:addPlayerRemovingCallback(function(player: Player, data: any): () print(player.Name .. " is leaving with data:", data) -- Perform any cleanup or save operations here end) local disconnect = Data.server:addPlayerRemovingCallback(function(player: Player, data: any): () data.currency = 0 end) -- Later, you can disconnect this function if needed disconnect()

searchDocs.title: waitForData​
searchDocs.content: This is a yielding function. When called, it will pause the Lua thread that called the function until a result is ready to be returned, without interrupting other scripts. Yields </> DataServer:waitForData(player: Player ) → Data? Waits for the player's data to be initialized and returns it. If the data is already available, it returns immediately. Returns nil if the player leaves before their data loads.

searchDocs.title: asyncGetProfile​
searchDocs.content: This is a yielding function. When called, it will pause the Lua thread that called the function until a result is ready to be returned, without interrupting other scripts. Yields </> DataServer:asyncGetProfile(userId: number | string) → Profile? Asynchronously retrieves the profile for the given user ID using internal ProfileStore.

searchDocs.title: getProfile​
searchDocs.content: </> DataServer:getProfile(player: Player ) → Profile? Retrieves the profile for the given player.

searchDocs.title: get​
searchDocs.content: </> DataServer:get( player: Player , should_assert: boolean? ) → value.value<T>? Returns the player's reactive data root. Pass true to error if the player's data is not loaded yet. Prefer :get(player) over indexing server[player] directly. -- returns nil if not loaded local playerData = Data.server:get(player) if playerData then playerData.currency(50) end -- errors if not loaded local playerData = Data.server:get(player, true) playerData.currency(50)

searchDocs.title: isLoaded​
searchDocs.content: </> DataServer:isLoaded(player: Player ) → boolean Returns whether the player's data has been loaded and is available through server[player]. if Data.server:isLoaded(player) then print(Data.server[player].coins()) end

searchDocs.title: Loading players​
searchDocs.content: create-player-data does not hook PlayerAdded for you. Call startSessionAsync yourself:  local Players = game:GetService 'Players' Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) local ok = Data:startSessionAsync(player) if not ok then player:Kick 'Could not load your data. Please rejoin.' end end)   startSessionAsync is idempotent — calling it for an already loaded player returns true immediately.

searchDocs.title: Accessing loaded data​
searchDocs.content: Always use :get(player) to access a player's data root:  local playerData = Data:get(player) playerData.currency(50)   If the data may not be loaded yet, omit the second argument (returns nil):  local playerData = Data:get(player) -- nil if not loaded if playerData then playerData.currency(50) end   Pass true to assert the data is loaded — throws an error otherwise:  local playerData = Data:get(player, true) -- errors if not loaded

searchDocs.title: Waiting for data from other scripts​
searchDocs.content: When another script might be loading the player, use waitForData:  local playerData = Data:waitForData(player) if playerData then playerData.currency(50) end   Yields until the data arrives, or returns nil if the player leaves before loading finishes.

searchDocs.title: Checking if loaded​
searchDocs.content: if Data:isLoaded(player) then local playerData = Data:get(player) print(playerData.currency()) end

searchDocs.title: Changing data​
searchDocs.content: The server is the source of truth. Writes here are authoritative and replicate to every client automatically. Use :get(player) to get the root, then mutate it:  local playerData = Data:get(player) playerData.currency(50) playerData.currency(function(currency) return currency + 10 end) playerData.questProgress.Insert(10) playerData.items.sword_001(nil)   See Values for the full read/write/listen API.

searchDocs.title: Lifecycle signals​
searchDocs.content: Three signals let you react to data loading and unloading:  Data.onSessionStart:connect(function(player) local playerData = Data:get(player) -- Apply defaults, run migrations, give starter items playerData.currency(100) end) Data.onSessionEnd:connect(function(player) -- Data saved and removed. Clean up server-side state. end) Data.onSessionFail:connect(function(player, reason) warn(player.Name, 'data load failed:', reason) end)

searchDocs.title: Ending sessions​
searchDocs.content: endSession saves and releases the profile without kicking the player:  Data:endSession(player)   resetData deletes the saved profile and kicks the player:  Data:resetData(player)   Use addPlayerRemovingCallback to run logic before a session ends. Returns a disconnect function:  local disconnect = Data:addPlayerRemovingCallback(function(player, data) data.lastLeaveTime = os.time() end)

searchDocs.title: Global messages​
searchDocs.content: Send data to a player even when they are on a different server:  Data:sendGlobalMessage("GiftCoins", userId, { amount = 100, from = "DailyReward", })   Handle these messages on the receiving server:  Data:addGlobalCallback("GiftCoins", function(player, data) local playerData = Data:get(player) if not playerData then return false end playerData.currency(function(currency) return currency + data.amount end) end)   Return false from the callback to leave the message unprocessed (it will be retried). Add the callback before any player loads — otherwise messages arriving during startup may be missed.

searchDocs.title: Profiles​
searchDocs.content: Access the raw ProfileStore profile for advanced use cases. getProfile returns the loaded profile for a player:  local profile = Data:getProfile(player) if profile then print(profile.Data.currency) end   asyncGetProfile loads a profile by user ID without starting a session. Useful for admin tools:  local profile = Data:asyncGetProfile(userId) if profile then print(profile.Data.currency) end
